title: Azure cloud services · Level 3
slo: Match common application needs to Azure service categories.

exercises.question_text: What does a production AI application need besides a model? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Correct. Production AI applications need security around their users, data, and services. A model alone does not provide that protection.
Correct. Production AI applications need networking for their connections. The model alone is not the complete operational system.
Correct. Applications need storage for data they save and retrieve. This is infrastructure around the model.
A model catalog can help select a model but is not a complete production application. Security, networking, hosting, scaling, storage, logic, and a user interface are also needed.
options.better_fit: Choose this when browsing or evaluating available models.

feedback.intrinsic: The team could select a model but still lack a secure, usable application.
feedback.instructional: A model is one component; production delivery needs supporting infrastructure and application components.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Production AI apps need supporting capabilities around a model.

exercises.question_text: Which category saves and manages cloud data?

options.rationale: Correct. Storage saves and manages cloud data. It keeps that data accessible later.
Compute runs applications and workloads. It is not the category for persistent cloud data.
options.better_fit: Choose this when an application or workload must run in the cloud.

feedback.intrinsic: This could leave data without a place to persist.
feedback.instructional: Storage retains data; compute runs work.

options.rationale: Networking connects cloud resources securely and efficiently. It does not save or manage cloud data.
options.better_fit: Choose this when resources need secure connections.

feedback.intrinsic: A connection would not provide persistent data management.
feedback.instructional: Networking handles communication; storage handles data.

options.rationale: App Services provide managed application hosting. They do not identify the category for retaining cloud data.
options.better_fit: Choose this when hosting an application without managing servers.

feedback.intrinsic: The app could be hosted while the data need remains unresolved.
feedback.instructional: App Services host applications; storage keeps their data.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Storage keeps cloud data available for later use.

exercises.question_text: App Services let teams build, host, and run applications without managing the underlying servers.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This could cause a team to overlook a managed hosting option.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: App Services are ready-made platforms for building, hosting, and running applications without server management.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Avoiding underlying server management is a key App Services benefit.

exercises.question_text: Azure is a cloud platform for building secure, reliable applications that can scale globally.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Marking this false could exclude Azure from a global application plan.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Azure is a cloud platform for building secure, reliable applications that can scale globally.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Azure supports secure, reliable applications at global scale.

exercises.question_text: An AI application needs a ___ so people can interact with it.

parts.text: so people can interact with it.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The completed sentence would not name the human interaction component.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use user interface, or UI, for the part people use.

exercises.explanation: A user interface is the component through which people interact with an application. It is one of the elements needed around an AI model.

exercises.question_text: A healthcare team must choose between additional cloud power for a diagnostic app and a service category for retaining backups. Its immediate decision is to preserve backups safely for later. Which choice fits best?

options.rationale: Correct. Backups are data that must be retained and accessed later. Storage directly addresses that immediate requirement.
Compute adds capacity for running the diagnostic application. It does not preserve backups for later use.
options.better_fit: Choose this when the diagnostic workload needs more running capacity.

feedback.intrinsic: The team could gain processing power but still lack backup retention.
feedback.instructional: Backups need storage; application execution needs compute.

options.rationale: Networking provides secure connections between resources. It does not provide persistent backup retention.
options.better_fit: Choose this when the app must securely connect to another resource.

feedback.intrinsic: Resources could connect while backups remain unprotected from loss.
feedback.instructional: Connectivity and persistent data storage are different needs.

options.rationale: App Services provide managed application hosting. They do not name the category for retaining backups.
options.better_fit: Choose this when the diagnostic app needs managed hosting.

feedback.intrinsic: The app could be hosted while backup retention remains unsolved.
feedback.instructional: Use storage for backups and App Services for managed app hosting.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Storage is the best fit for retaining backups.

exercises.question_text: A retail team is deciding how to host its product-recommendation web app. It can rent cloud computers or use a ready-made app platform, and it does not want to manage servers. Which choice best fits?

options.rationale: Correct. The team prefers a ready-made platform without server management. App Services provide that managed hosting approach.

options.error_type: Confuses cloud computers with managed hosting
options.rationale: Compute is like renting cloud computers for workloads. The scenario favors managed hosting instead of managing servers.
options.better_fit: Choose this when the team needs adjustable capacity to run a workload.

feedback.intrinsic: The team could rent capacity but still face management work it wants to avoid.
feedback.instructional: Compute supplies cloud computers; App Services provide managed hosting.

options.error_type: Confuses hosting choice with data persistence
options.rationale: Storage retains data but does not decide how the web app is hosted. The decision point is the hosting model.
options.better_fit: Choose this when product images, data, or backups must be retained.

feedback.intrinsic: The team could preserve data without solving application hosting.
feedback.instructional: Storage is for persistence; App Services address managed hosting.

options.rationale: Networking handles secure communication, not managed server operation. It does not satisfy the team's hosting preference.
options.better_fit: Choose this when the web app must securely connect to other resources.

feedback.intrinsic: The app could have connectivity while its hosting decision remains unresolved.
feedback.instructional: Networking solves connectivity needs; App Services solve managed hosting needs.

exercises.explanation: Correct. App Services are the ready-made, managed hosting choice.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the pieces to form a correct statement.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The statement would not clearly describe compute.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Start with the category, then state the ability and where it is used.

exercises.correct_answer: Compute is the ability to run applications in the cloud
exercises.explanation: Compute is the ability to run applications in the cloud. The order first identifies the category, then states its function.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the pieces to form a correct statement.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The statement would not clearly communicate networking's purpose.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: State the networking tool first, followed by its connection action and benefit.

exercises.correct_answer: Networking tools connect cloud resources to each other securely and efficiently
exercises.explanation: Networking tools connect cloud resources to each other securely and efficiently. The statement identifies the tool, action, connection target, and manner.

exercises.question_text: A manufacturer operates a custom failure-prediction workload. Demand rises, and the engineer must decide how to make its cloud computer capacity adjustable. Which choices best fit? Select all that apply.

options.text: Use compute to run the prediction workload
options.rationale: Correct. Compute runs the custom prediction workload. It provides the execution resources the system needs.
Correct. Compute can scale up or down as demand changes. Scaling directly addresses the increased demand in this scenario.

options.text: Use storage to execute the predictions
options.rationale: Storage preserves data but does not execute prediction workloads. The decision concerns processing capacity, which is compute.
options.better_fit: Choose this when prediction records or backups need to be retained.

feedback.intrinsic: The workload would still lack execution capacity.
feedback.instructional: Storage keeps information; compute runs the workload.

options.text: Use networking to add CPU capacity
options.rationale: Networking enables communication rather than CPU capacity. Increasing cloud computer capacity is a compute decision.
options.better_fit: Choose this when the workload must connect securely to other resources.

feedback.intrinsic: The system could connect successfully but remain short of processing power.
feedback.instructional: Networking connects resources; compute supplies adjustable processing capacity.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Compute runs the workload and can be scaled as demand increases.

exercises.question_text: A manufacturing team needs two cloud resources to communicate safely while its maintenance databases remain available later. Which choices address only the communication problem? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Correct. Networking connects cloud resources to each other. It directly addresses the communication problem.
Correct. This describes the required communication outcome. Networking provides that secure, efficient connectivity.

options.text: Storage to make the resources communicate
options.rationale: Storage preserves the maintenance databases but does not connect the resources. The question isolates the communication requirement.
options.better_fit: Choose this for the databases that must remain available later.

feedback.intrinsic: The databases could be retained while the resources remain unable to communicate.
feedback.instructional: Storage persists databases; networking connects resources.

options.rationale: Compute runs workloads but does not provide the secure connection. The scenario's decision point is communication between resources.
options.better_fit: Choose this when a maintenance workload needs cloud execution capacity.

feedback.intrinsic: More capacity would not necessarily establish communication.
feedback.instructional: Compute executes workloads; networking provides connectivity.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Networking solves the communication need, while storage serves the separate database need.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The completed statement would not name Microsoft's cloud platform.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use Azure as the platform name.

exercises.explanation: Azure is Microsoft's cloud platform. Compute, storage, networking, and App Services are categories available through cloud platforms.
